basic_info.description: Assumable loan at 2.625%. Charming Semi-Detached Home with Privacy and Convenience.  Discover the perfect blend of comfort and tranquility in this 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home. Enclosed by elegant cedar fences, the front yard features a jasmine-covered arbor and twinkling bistro lights ideal for quiet moments or intimate gatherings.  Inside, an open-concept living and dining area with vaulted ceilings creates a welcoming space, while the updated galley kitchen, featuring a chef-inspired Forno 6-burner stove, invites culinary adventures. Both bedrooms are bathed in natural light, and the remodeled bathroom boasts a bright skylight for a refreshing ambiance.    Practical amenities include a laundry area and pantry, but the real gem is the private outdoor oasis. Enjoy al fresco dining, weekend barbecues, and relaxation in your very own sauna. The lush backyard, adorned with mature trees, offers ample space to cultivate your green sanctuary.  Easy access to highways 101 & 280 and Alemany Farmer's Market.
